name: Evropská dálková trasa E10, Česká republika, Severočeský kraj
description_md:
The Evropská dálková trasa E10 in the Severočeský kraj region of the Czech Republic is an international waymarked hiking network route signed as E10. This hard route covers a distance of 85.4 km.

The walk involves 2131 m of ascent and 2216 m of descent. It is classified as a waymarked hiking route. The walking time takes about 27 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Difficulty is derived from distance and ascent.
